definitions.explanation: The hard outer covering of eggs, nuts, or shellfish.
The outer covering of grains or seeds.

examples.japanese: {卵|たまご}の{殻|から}を{剥|む}く。
{殻|から}を{破|やぶ}って{出|で}てきた。
examples.english: It broke through the shell and came out.

notes:
{殻|から} refers to hard outer coverings.

TYPES:
- {卵|たまご}の{殻|から}: eggshell
- {貝殻|かいがら}: seashell
- {木|き}の{実|み}の{殻|から}: nutshell

FIGURATIVE:
{殻|から}を{破|やぶ}る means to break out of one's shell (overcome shyness).
